## Purpose

Add a pointer in `docs/training/weight_transfer/nccl.md` (Examples) to the trainer-free checkpoint publisher and weight-update verifier on the `vllm-state-transition-verifier` branch (imported in #65291). Use it to push a local Hugging Face checkpoint into a running `vllm serve` over NCCL and check the update with fixed-token and GSM8K comparisons, before integrating an RL framework.

The link resolves once #65291 lands on that branch.

## Test Plan

Docs only.

@@ -4,6 +4,9 @@ The Weight Checker verifies that an RL weight update landed on every rank. It
 hashes each model parameter with SHA-256, so a caller can save the original
 digests, reset the weights, transfer them back, and confirm they match.
 
+To also check generated outputs before and after an update, see
+[Verifying a New Model Without a Trainer](weight_transfer/README.md#verifying-a-new-model-without-a-trainer).
+
 Enable it with `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1`. All operations use

@@ -150,6 +150,21 @@ engine = WeightTransferTrainerFactory.trainer_init(
 engine.send_weights()  # called on every rank
 ```
 
+## Verifying a New Model Without a Trainer
+
+To check that weight updates work for a new model before wiring up an RL
+framework, the [checkpoint publisher and weight-update verifier](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/vllm-state-transition-verifier/tools/state_transition_verifier) on the
+`vllm-state-transition-verifier` branch pushes a local Hugging Face checkpoint
+into a running `vllm serve` over NCCL, without a trainer, and compares
+fixed-token outputs and GSM8K accuracy before and after the update. Get it with:
+
+```bash
+git fetch origin vllm-state-transition-verifier
+git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- tools/state_transition_verifier
+```
+
+and start from `tools/state_transition_verifier/README.md`.
+
 ## API Endpoints
 
 When running vLLM as an HTTP server, the following endpoints are available for weight transfer. `HTTPVLLMWeightSyncClient` speaks the first five for you. A trainer may also implement the protocol directly without importing vLLM: see the wire contracts in [NCCL](nccl.md#trainer-without-vllm-over-http) and [IPC](ipc.md#trainer-without-vllm-over-http). This keeps the trainer decoupled from vLLM: it needs no vLLM install or version pin, only this documented HTTP and wire contract, so trainer and server can upgrade independently (non-PyTorch trainers such as JAX can use it too).

 - [RLHF with sparse NCCL weight syncing (offline, Ray)](../../../examples/rl/rlhf_sparse_nccl.py) - Qwen3 MoE per-expert checkpoint updates with one trainer GPU and two TP2/EP2 inference GPUs
 - [RLHF with async weight syncing (offline, Ray)](../../../examples/rl/rlhf_async_new_apis.py) - Async generation with mid-flight pause, weight sync, resume, and validation against a fresh model; uses an in-process `AsyncLLMEngine` with `RayVLLMWeightSyncClient`

Get it with `git fetch origin vllm-state-transition-verifier && git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- tools/state_transition_verifier`, then start from `tools/state_transition_verifier/README.md`
